radii.rule: no square corners in the signed-in app

elevation.rule: offset plus soft blur, tinted by the ink; declared once per element, shadow only

bans: kicker or eyebrow above a heading

motion.signature: the goal deck fans from an overlapped stack and restacks when the combination changes (45ms per-card stagger)
motion.reducedMotion: every duration collapses to 1ms; the deck defaults to fanned

components.pass: .pass — the week, full-bleed accent gradient, display figure, day strip opening the month calendar
components.goalPass: .goal-pass / .goal-card — per-goal accent tint in four steps, gradient mark tile, 7-dot week
components.ring: .app-ring — conic-gradient progress; dashed outline when empty; count repeated as text
components.shell: .app — 76px labelled rail on desktop, bottom tab bar under 860px, sticky translucent top bar
components.dialog: .app-dialog — centred card, bottom sheet under 860px, focus trap and scroll lock
components.calendar: .cal — six Monday-led weeks, gradient for logged days, dashed for past empty days

accessibility.contrast: 140 checks across 10 themes, all passing at 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for fills
accessibility.targets: 44px on coarse pointers; 36px minimum with spacing on fine pointers
accessibility.focus: never suppressed; inverts to --color-on-accent inside the pass
accessibility.headings: one h1 per page (top bar title); regions labelled by h2
accessibility.colorAlone: never carries meaning — progress states also read as text
